card._comment: MusicBase 420x636 native from prefab. heightRatio 0.78 + topMargin 0.16 gives enough room above for the MBase_Tab (which extends ~104 native px above card top, i.e. ~138 output px at this scale).

_stillTextModeComment: Still cover export only: how over-long title/artist/designer/BPM are handled. 'shrink' = shrink the font to fit the whole string; 'ellipsis' = keep the base font size and clip the tail with '…'. The animated intro ignores this (it always marquee-scrolls). Set per-export from the cover dialog.
_lvRenderModeComment: How the LV value is drawn. 'atlas' = the pre-baked digit sprite sheet (only [0-9] and '+'); 'text' = render the raw level STRING with the bundled Heavy font (no 'Lv' prefix, supports arbitrary characters). In 'atlas' mode the card AUTO-FALLS-BACK to text rendering whenever the level string contains a character the atlas can't render, so input is never silently dropped.

marquee._comment: Over-long title/artist/designer/BPM CONTINUOUSLY LOOP (scroll left, wrap with a gap) in the animated intro (revealStartFrame>=0). The still cover export shrinks-then-left-aligns instead (a still can't scroll). Frame-driven (NOT QML animation, which never ticks under the headless export loop). Values in card-native px / authoring frames (60fps). scrollPxPerFrame is intentionally slow.

lvRendered._comment: Per-difficulty palette for the 'text' LV render mode, echoing the baked numerals: near-white fill + a difficulty-coloured outline + a soft dark drop shadow. Stroke matches MiaCode's difficultyColor() palette (MainWindowShared.cpp); shadow is a darkened shade of it.

lvAtlas._comment: Per-difficulty digit/symbol atlases. Each atlas is 192x240, 4x4 grid of 48x60 cells. Cell index 0-9 = digit, 10='+', 11='-', 12=',', 13='·', 14='LV' label. EASY/UTAGE (ids 1/7) are fan-made hue-recolours (Easy blue #69A6FF, Utage orange #E29A46) — see tools/lvcard_gen/recolor_difficulty_cards.py.

fonts._comment: Resource Han Rounded CN (思源圆体, rounded Source Han, OFL) — covers full simplified Chinese natively (no system fallback) and approximates SEGA's MaruGothic rounded look. Title uses Heavy for prominence; body uses Bold. Replaced the prior M PLUS 1p Black / M PLUS Rounded 1c Bold pair.

layout._comment: Coords in card-native (420x636). From prefab MusicBase + descendants, with parent-pivot offsets folded in. y is +Y down (top-left origin); Unity values converted via (210+ux, 318-uy).
layout._layoutComment: Square jacket restored: window is 320x320 at (51,42). Tab+plates raised 18px (y-36->-54, y-31->-49) so the shoulder sits on the card's top border instead of overlapping the jacket — keeps the visible 曲绘 a clean 1:1. Card canvas (420x636) + heightRatio/topMargin unchanged, so the card BOTTOM edge stays fixed.
